proved_scope: Explicit local primitive coverage: omitted visible direct rows must be B; local W/R/ownB are production adapter obligations.
A composed paired relation has a primitive static-source last seed and static-target first seed, with their exact endpoints and symbolic mark bounds.
C5 either has an exact primitive local pair or both selected target/source endpoint gates are positive; a negative gate constructs the local pair witness.
C2 either has an exact primitive local entry or the selected FLOW-reader/shared-B target gate is positive; a negative gate constructs the local entry witness.
A mapped local terminal fixes the complete modeled target and output selector for C2, independent of the preceding relation.
Under the explicit colored-rejects-actual-FLOW emitter contract, every emitted static-guidance entry is directly abstract local or visible shared FLOW B; a nonstatic FLOW result is always local.

Finite witnesses: W-R needs no B; a mapped R is C2-local but its C5 source needs a writer prefix; a FLOW R gains a concrete nonstatic return only by prefix color transport; an unmatched intermediate source must not stop C5; carry works with no graph or positive gate.
not_proved: Production AP path-index containment/near completeness, all-run tail/E/mx/limit transport, packed leaves or ND member union.
Construction of complete local W/R/ownB references and shared B visibility from exact MethodKey/CommonMethod ownership.
Concrete genuine ZERO selector/binding rules; the graph has ordinary/static vertices and the existing ZERO/carry adapters remain separate.
Actual worklist scheduler/fairness/termination-state adapter, unrestricted AP reassociation or full JVM equivalence.
Exact protection-mask payload keys, native persistence ownership, runtime implementation or measured performance savings.
